description: This file stays at the repository root; Renovate ignores nested copies without error.
Match paths are repository-root-relative and move with their targets; a stale path selects nothing without failing.
Minor and patch updates automerge after quarantine; major and vulnerability updates require review unless a technical constraint below overrides the policy.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
